mechanism: On activation, accept load at `initial_capacity` and raise the accepted-load cap to full over `ramp_duration`, following `curve`. This prevents a thundering herd against a cold system. What the ramp establishes is the cap, not readiness — a system whose cap has reached full may still be cold inside. Utilizes {{greet}}, {{throttle}}.
gloss: Gradual capacity increase to stabilize cold systems
failure_modes: Premature Load: Traffic arrives before warmup completes.
False Warmth: Timer completes but internal state (e.g. cache) is still cold.
postconditions: Accepted-load cap has reached full capacity
{{system}} is accepting load at full cap — readiness of internal state (caches, compiled paths) is a separate signal this pattern does not assert

parameters.name: initial_capacity
parameters.description: Starting capacity as fraction of full (0 = cold start)

parameters.name: ramp_duration
parameters.description: Time to reach full capacity from initial
